title: 2026 NAEI inventory methodology and QA/QC controls

facts.source_fact: The UK Greenhouse Gas Inventory is compiled consistently with relevant IPCC guidance.
facts.expected_handling: Carry international-methodology provenance with inventory estimates.

facts.source_fact: The wider inventory system also uses relevant EMEP-EEA guidance for air-pollutant inventory work.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix pollutant and GHG method scopes without identification.

facts.source_fact: Inventory estimates use information ranging from national energy statistics to data from individual industrial plants.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve source-type provenance by estimate.

facts.source_fact: Calculation-method improvements are normally implemented before each annual inventory compilation.
facts.expected_handling: Version methods by inventory submission year.

facts.source_fact: Method improvements may respond to UNFCCC centralised, in-country, bilateral and peer-review recommendations.
facts.expected_handling: Retain review-origin provenance for methodology changes.

facts.source_fact: Relevant DESNZ, Defra and other sponsored research can feed inventory-method improvements.
facts.expected_handling: Carry research provenance when methods change.

facts.source_fact: Inventory preparation includes controlled data requests and tracking of received information.
facts.expected_handling: Require traceable source receipt for activity data.

facts.source_fact: Annual preparation includes verification checks intended to identify anomalous or inconsistent source data.
facts.expected_handling: Flag anomalies before estimate publication.

facts.source_fact: The annual workflow processes source data and estimates emissions using the latest applicable datasets and methods.
facts.expected_handling: Keep input-vintage and method-vintage metadata.

facts.source_fact: Quality control includes time-series and outlier checking.
facts.expected_handling: Do not accept unexplained discontinuities as valid by default.

facts.source_fact: The workflow includes draft reporting, review and publication stages.
facts.expected_handling: Distinguish draft estimates from published inventory values.

facts.source_fact: The annual process includes formal archiving after inventory production.
facts.expected_handling: Preserve frozen-version references for reproducibility.

facts.source_fact: NAEI maintains an online manual system defining timetables, database updates, document control and checking procedures.
facts.expected_handling: Carry procedure-version provenance with QA records.

facts.source_fact: Data received are logged and numbered so they can be traced back to source through the system.
facts.expected_handling: Reject untraceable source inputs for high-confidence use.

facts.source_fact: The inventory database contains activity data and emission factors with source references.
facts.expected_handling: Keep activity-data and factor provenance separately traceable.

facts.source_fact: The database explicitly identifies units for activity and emission-factor data.
facts.expected_handling: Require unit metadata before calculations or comparison.

facts.source_fact: When estimate methodologies are revised, previous years are recalculated as a matter of course.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix old-vintage historical values with recalculated series.

facts.source_fact: The inventory system estimates uncertainties in emissions estimates.
facts.expected_handling: Carry uncertainty context with inventory values.

facts.source_fact: Final QA includes a designated-auditor exercise asking why sources changed from the previous year.
facts.expected_handling: Require explanation for significant year-on-year changes.

facts.source_fact: Electronic inventory information and databases are backed up regularly under the QA/QC system.
facts.expected_handling: Treat backup/archival controls as integrity evidence, not emissions evidence.

guard_patterns.handling: Preserve inventory-method facts and source roles.
Attach inventory, pollutant/GHG, source category and estimation boundary.
Attach inventory year and methodology revision vintage.
guard_patterns.risk_prevented: Prevents mixing recalculated and superseded time series.

guard_patterns.handling: Carry source, factor, unit, QA/QC and review provenance.
Do not convert national inventory methodology into parcel-level measured emissions.

generation_rule: CARTESIAN_PRODUCT facts x guard_patterns; control_id={package_id}_{fact_id}_{pattern_id}; each generated row inherits confidence_percent=99 and verification=PASS
